title: Waiting for a six
caption: The first six on the 4th roll means three non-sixes then a six: (5/6)³ × 1/6 = 125/1296 ≈ 0.0965. The mean wait is 1/p = 6 rolls.
alt: Bar chart of the geometric distribution with p = 1/6 for rolls 1 to 20; the bar at 4 is shaded.
description: Each bar is P(first six on roll k), falling by a factor 5/6 each step.
The bar at k = 4 has height (5/6)³ × 1/6 ≈ 0.0965.
